Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def solve(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    mid=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(x==5 for x in r)][0]
    ub=[r[:] for r in g[:mid]]; lb=[r[:] for r in g[mid+1:]]
    vals=sorted(set(x for r in g for x in r)-{0,5})
    # duplicated color = one appearing in lower band
    dup=[v for v in vals if any(v in r for r in lb)]
    X=dup[0]
    Y=max(vals)  # surviving other (matches all demos: kept max color + dup)
    ptsX=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(lb) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==X]
    ptsY=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(ub) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==Y]
    o=[[0]*w for _ in range(h-mid)]
    # X at lower-copy position
    for i,j in ptsX: o[i-mid-1][j]=X
    # Y adjacent to X below, same columns (fits demos 3,4; color rule says below when Y-X>=5)
    minY=min(p[0] for p in ptsY); maxX=min(p[0] for p in ptsX)
    r0=maxX+1
    for i,j in ptsY:
        if (i,j)+(r0-minY,0) and True:
            o[r0+((i)-minY)][j]=Y
    return o

    if not m:

t=G['Test input']
mid=5; ub=t[:5]; lb=t[mid+1:]
def pts(S,c): return [(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(S) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]

dmax=max(p[0] for p in pts(lb,1))
for i,j in ecol:
    r=dmax+1+(i-e0)
    if r<9: out[r][j]=8
for row in out: print(''.join(map(str,row)))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def pts(S,c): return [(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(S) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
# Rule (verified mentally on demos 3,4, and test): dup color = appears in both bands. Its copy (from BOTTOM band)
# is stamped in output at SAME absolute row-offset within output as its bottom copy had relative to mid: 
# i.e. out_row = abs_row - 6 (mid+1) — same as demos where dup out rows were 1-3 and 3-5 respectively.
# EXTRA: largest top-band color != dup (demo3: c6, demo4: c7). It takes ITS TOP BAND SHAPE and is stamped
# starting right below the dup copy, with its bbox's COLUMNS aligned to the DUP COPY's columns (not its own!).
# Check demo4: extra c7 input top shape cols 10-12 -> stamped cols 8-10 = dup cols. rows 6-8 right below rows 3-5.
def f(g):
    mid=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(x==5 for x in r)][0]
    ub,lb=g[:mid],g[mid+1:]
    def p(S,c): return {(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(S) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c}
    dup=min(set(x for r in ub for x in r)&set(x for r in lb for x in r))
    others=sorted(set(x for r in ub for x in r)-{dup})
    extra=max(others,default=None)
    dp=p(lb,dup); dj0=min(j for _,j in dp); dw=max(j for _,j in dp)-dj0+1
    e0=min(i for i,_ in p(ub,extra)); ej0=min(j for i,j in p(ub,extra))
    out=[[0]*15 for _ in range(9)]
    for i,j in dp: out[i-6][j]=dup      # mid+1=6
    if extra is not None:
        for i,j in p(ub,extra):
            out[dmaxp+1+(i-e0)][dj0+(j-ej0)%dw if False else dj0+(j-ej0-dj0+dj0-dj0 if False else (j-ej0)*0+dj0+(j%dw))]=extra
    return out
for n in [3,4]:
    g=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; o=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print(n,f(g)==o)

def pts(S,c): return [(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(S) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
def f(g):
    Hh,Ww=len(g),len(g[0])
    mid=[i for i in range(len(g)) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]!=0][0]
    ub,lb=g[:mid],g[mid+1:]
    tcols={x for r in ub for x in r}-{0}
    bcols={x for r in lb for x in r}-{0}
    dup=min(tcols&bcols); others=tcols-bcols
    extra=max(others) if others else None
    # all points absolute in full grid
    def pS(g,S,c): return [(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
    dp=pS(g,lb,dup); ep=pS(g,ub,extra)
    dt=min(i for i,_ in dp); de=max(i for i,_ in dp); dl=min(j for _,j in dp)
    et=min(i for i,_ in ep); eh=max(i for i,_ in ep)-et+1
    out=[[0]*Ww for _ in range(Hh)]
    for i,j in dp: out[i][j]=dup
    if extra is not None:
        sh=(dl - min(j for _,j in ep))   # left-align extra to dup columns
        for i,j in ep: out[(et) + (et-de-h+1)*0 + (de+1) + (i-et)][j+sh]=extra
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def pts(S,c): return [(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(S) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
def f(g,H=None):
    W=len(g[0]); mid=[i for i in range(len(g)) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]==5][0]
    top=g[:mid]; bot=g[mid+1:]
    dc={x for r in bot for x in r}-{0}; tc={x for r in top for x in r}-{0}
    d=min(tc&dc); e=max(tc-dc)
    dp=pts(bot,d); ep=pts(top,e)
    dl=min(j for _,j in dp)
    dt=min(i for i,_ in dp); dh=max(i for i,_ in dp)-dt+1
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i,j in dp: out[i][j]=d
    et=min(i for i,_ in ep)
    for i,j in ep: out[dt+dh+i-et][j]=e
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def pts(S,c): return [(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(S) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
def solve(g,H):
    W=len(g[0]); mid=[i for i in range(len(g)) if len(set(g[i]))==1 and g[i][0]==5][0]
    top=g[:mid]; bot=g[mid+1:]
    dc={x for r in bot for x in r}-{0}; tc={x for r in top for x in r}-{0}
    d=min(tc&dc); e=max(tc-dc)
    dp=pts(bot,d); ep=pts(top,e)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i,j in dp: out[i][j]=d
    dt=min(i for i,_ in dp)
    # extra rows just below dup bottom
    for i,j in ep: out[dt+(max(i for i,_ in dp)-dt)+1+i-min(i for i,_ in ep)][j-(min(j for _,j in dp)-min(j for _,j in ep))]=e
    return out
for n,(H,ec) in {(3,9):6,(4,9):7}.items():
    o=solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],H); print(n,o==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
o=solve(G['Test input'],11)
for r in o: print(''.join(map(str,r)))
print(json.dumps(o))
